page.content:
Phlias was the son of Dionysus and Araethyrea (daughter of Aras). He married Chthonophyle, who had his son Androdamas. The town of Phlius (formerly called Araethyrea) was believed to have derived its name from him.

page.overview:
Who is Phlias?

Phlias was the son of Dionysus and Araethyrea (daughter of Aras). He married Chthonophyle, who had his son Androdamas. The town of Phlius (formerly called Araethyrea) was believed to have derived its name from him.
